hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && ruff check --quiet "$f" 2>&1 | head -20 || true; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.env|.env) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct .env edits are not permitted — use .env.example instead"}}'; exit 2;; esac; }
